title: Add wave function to orgos/agile/wave.py
body:
Implement wave(name: str) -> str that returns f'wave to {name}'. Add the function to orgos/agile/wave.py with a proper docstring. No other logic.

Files: orgos/agile/wave.py

Done: function exists and works.

votes.justification: I hold my estimate of 1 point because devsecops provided no justification to justify a higher value, and the task remains trivially simple with no security or operational concerns. Their vote without explanation does not change my assessment.
The change is trivial and well-defined; no edge cases or dependencies were missed. I hold my estimate.

My 5-point estimate remains because even trivial functions can introduce deployment risks if the file is imported unsafely or the function name conflicts; architect and test's low estimates miss the need for a release-aware check.

comments.author: scrum_master
comments.body: Post-refinement votes still divergent: [1, 1, 5]. Blocking for PO re-scope.
